title.en: a Pinjin Concrete Pump Moves Concrete keeps its own figures; Concrete block is only the picture
title.zh: 品锦混凝土泵怎样输送混凝土保留自己的数字，「Concrete block」只是配图

description.en: a Pinjin Concrete Pump Moves Concrete. 80 mm stays in the catalogue entry. Illustration: Concrete block.
description.zh: 品锦混凝土泵怎样输送混凝土。80 mm仍在目录格子里。插图来自「Concrete block」。

h1.en: a Pinjin Concrete Pump Moves Concrete keeps its own figures; Concrete block is only the picture
h1.zh: 品锦混凝土泵怎样输送混凝土保留自己的数字，「Concrete block」只是配图

directAnswer.en: A concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai moves concrete from a hopper into a delivery pipe. That is the path the catalogue describes. The picture is from https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block.
directAnswer.zh: 河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，把混凝土从料斗送进输送管。配件目录写明S阀活塞、S管密封、主油缸密封和摆缸密封。图片来自https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block。

body.en: Image from the source page: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block. The picture shows Concreteblocks. A concrete pump from Hebei Pinjin Machinery in Xingtai moves concrete from a hopper into a delivery pipe. The sheets do not list cylinder bore, piston stroke or strokes per minute, so this note does not invent a timed cycle. Hebei Pinjin Machinery builds these machines in Xingtai. Separate lines name an S-tube seal, a main-cylinder seal, a swing-cylinder seal and a swing-arm ball. Do not draw piston speed, cylinder diameter or strokes per minute for a Hebei Pinjin Machinery concrete pump.
body.zh: 图来自来源页：https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block。画面是Concreteblocks。河北品锦机械在邢台的混凝土泵，把混凝土从料斗送进输送管。混凝土从该页写出的管道离开，不是从车载布料杆离开。如果项目需要页面没标出的结构尺寸，请通过 /zh/contact/ 询问，空白格子保持空白。

body.en: That is the path the catalogue describes. Many concrete pump sheets list a hopper capacity. The concrete leaves through the pipe the page names, not through a truck placing boom. Those names tell you the vocabulary of the circuit. Those figures are absent.
body.zh: 配件目录写明S阀活塞、S管密封、主油缸密封和摆缸密封。另外的行写明 S 管密封、主油缸密封、摆缸密封和摆臂球头。

body.en: Some pump pages also name a hydraulic pump, such as a Kawasaki unit. Pages that list a delivery-pipe diameter name that diameter only for themselves: Electric 20 lists 80 mm, Electric 15 lists 100–125 mm, and the integrated mixer, HBT8018, HBT80-16 and LZ-60 list 100 / 125 mm. The spare-parts category calls the wear range S-valve parts. They do not publish bore, stroke, swing angle or a step order. Do not turn the parts names into a replacement procedure.
body.zh: 参数页不标出缸径、活塞行程或每分钟冲程，因此这里不编造一套带节拍的循环。这些名称给出回路用词，并没有公布缸径、行程、摆角或步骤顺序。

body.en: The parts list names S-valve pistons, an S-tube seal, a main-cylinder seal and a swing-cylinder seal. Pages without a pipe entry do not receive a borrowed diameter. The split-piston line says the set is for S-valve concrete pumps. A Kawasaki name on a pump row is the hydraulic-pump entry, not a displacement. If a project needs a structural size the page does not list, ask through /en/contact/ and keep the blank entry blank.
body.zh: 标出了输送管内径的页面，管径只属于自己：电动20为 80 mm，电动15为 100–125 mm，搅拌泵一体机、HBT8018、HBT80-16 和 LZ-60 为 100 / 125 mm。不要为河北品锦机械的混凝土泵画活塞速度、缸径或每分钟冲程。

question.en: Does the catalogue list piston stroke?

answer.en: No. Hebei Pinjin Machinery does not list piston stroke, cylinder bore or strokes per minute on the Xingtai concrete pump sheets. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block.
answer.zh: 没有。河北品锦机械没有在邢台混凝土泵参数页写出活塞行程、缸径或每分钟冲程。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Where does the concrete leave the machine?
question.zh: 混凝土从机器哪里离开？

answer.en: Through the delivery pipe named on that model page. If the page has no pipe diameter, do not borrow one from another concrete pump. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block.
answer.zh: 通过该型号页写出的输送管。如果该页没有管径，不要向另一台混凝土泵借用。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: What does a Kawasaki line mean?
question.zh: 川崎这一行是什么意思？

answer.en: It is the hydraulic-pump name shown on that concrete pump page. The entry does not add a displacement figure. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block.
answer.zh: 它是该混凝土泵页面写出的液压泵名称。这一格没有附带排量。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block画面里印出的数字。

question.en: On this row: Is there a published pumping-cycle diagram?
question.zh: 有没有公布的泵送循环图？

answer.en: No timed cycle is shown. The published path is hopper to delivery pipe, plus the assembly names on the parts list. It is not a figure printed inside https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block.
answer.zh: 没有写出带节拍的循环。已公布的路径是料斗到输送管，再加上配件清单上的总成名称。它不是https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Concrete_block画面里印出的数字。
